sql:
SELECT fee_component, SUM(COALESCE(amount, 0)) AS amount
FROM zs_refined.myntra_settlement s
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(
  ARRAY['gross_commission','mp_fees','pick_and_pack_fee','payment_gateway_fee','fixed_fee','freight_charge','freight_charge_gst','reverse_prepaid_charges','reverse_postpaid_charges','marketing_charges_prepaid','marketing_charges_postpaid','royaltycharges_prepaid','royaltycharges_postpaid'],
  ARRAY[gross_commission, mp_fees, pick_and_pack_fee, payment_gateway_fee, fixed_fee, freight_charge, freight_charge_gst, reverse_prepaid_charges, reverse_postpaid_charges, marketing_charges_prepaid, marketing_charges_postpaid, royaltycharges_prepaid, royaltycharges_postpaid]
) AS t(fee_component, amount)
WHERE s.is_active = true
  AND s.group_level_id = <client_id>
GROUP BY fee_component
ORDER BY fee_component;

sql:
SELECT r.order_id, r.item_id,
       SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)) AS expected_refund_amount,
       SUM(COALESCE(s.settled_amount, 0)) AS reverse_settlement_amount,
       SUM(COALESCE(s.settled_amount, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)) AS variance_amount,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(s.order_id) = 0 THEN 'reverse_missing_settlement' ELSE 'matched_or_amount_review' END AS recon_status
FROM zs_observe.myntra_reverse r
LEFT JOIN zs_refined.myntra_settlement s
  ON r.order_id = s.order_id
 AND r.item_id = s.item_id
 AND s.transaction_type = 'reverse'
 AND s.is_active = true
 AND s.group_level_id = r.group_level_id
WHERE r.is_active = true
  AND r.group_level_id = <client_id>
GROUP BY r.order_id, r.item_id;
